title: Parmesan and Thyme Stuffed Mushrooms
summary: Mushroom caps are roasted until browned, then filled with a garlic, shallot, Parmesan, thyme and breadcrumb stuffing and baked briefly until crisp on top.
equipment: large rimmed baking tray lined with foil

ingredients.item: large white mushrooms (4-5 cm across, about 700 g)
fine sea salt or table salt
flat-leaf parsley, chopped, plus leaves to garnish
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Roast the caps
steps.text: Roast the oiled, seasoned caps gill side up for 20 minutes, flip and roast 10 minutes more.

steps.title: Chop the stems
steps.text: Pulse the stems, shallot and garlic until fine.

steps.title: Cook the stuffing
steps.text: Fry the stem mixture in oil for about 5 minutes until dry and golden, then cool.

steps.title: Season
steps.text: Mix in the breadcrumbs, Parmesan, thyme, lemon juice, parsley and salt.

steps.title: Fill and bake
steps.text: Stuff the caps and bake 6-8 minutes until golden on top.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Garnish with parsley and serve warm.

tips: Roasting the caps first drives off water so they are not soggy.
Cook the stems until really dry for a firm stuffing.
Stuff a day ahead and add a few minutes to the final bake.
storage: Refrigerate within 2 hours and eat within 2 days, reheated in a hot oven until piping hot.
